data.description: A Conveniently Accessible Community Surrounded by Beaches and Wetlands.

data.answer:
It is divided into several themed districts, each with its unique charm and appeal.

  • The Granada community provides residents with green surroundings and beachfront properties, creating a serene and picturesque living environment. It was the first phase of the district.
  • Malibu sub-community features beachfront properties nestled among white coral beaches, offering a unique coastal lifestyle.You can find kids play area and the unique Oasis Walk in Malibu.
  • The Lagoons offers 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with spectacular views of the lagoon, allowing residents to enjoy scenic vistas from their windows.
  • Bermuda neighborhood offers 2 to 6-bedroom villas and townhouses surrounded by protected coastal wetlands and beaches, providing a tranquil and natural living environment.
  • Flamingo Villas, located along the shoreline, are perfect for large families looking to settle in Mina Al Arab, offering spacious and luxurious living spaces.
  • Lagoon Marina sub-community is ideal for watersports enthusiasts, offering facilities for sailing, motorboating, and other water activities.
  • Lagoon Walk is an ideal community for singles, serving as the cultural center of Mina Al Arab with trendy shopping outlets and casual dining spots.

Whether it’s a waterfront villa or a cozy townhouse, each home is crafted to the highest standards of luxury and comfort. The properties are meticulously designed to provide stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, lush landscapes, and serene lagoons. Residents enjoy a range of high-end amenities, such as private beaches, parks, swimming pools, and fitness centers, all within a secure, gated community.

The thoughtfully planned neighborhoods ensure a harmonious blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience, making Mina Al Arab an ideal choice for those seeking a tranquil yet vibrant lifestyle.

Buying a Property in Mina Al Arab

Looking for properties for sale in Mina Al Arab? Studios, averaging 415 sq. ft. with 1 bathroom, are priced at least AED 340,000. 1-bedroom apartments, offering about 886 sq. ft. of living space and two bathrooms, might be available for AED 440,000. 2-bedroom units, with around 1,328 sq. ft. of space and 3 bathrooms, are priced at around AED 837,000. The largest apartments, 3-bedroom units with over 1,800 sq. ft. of floor space, cost AED 1.27 million minimum.

Villas in Mina Al Arab include a 3-bedroom villa with approximately 2,300 sq. ft. of floor space, typically priced at AED 1.4 million. For larger homes, 4-bedroom villas with around 5,000 sq. ft. of floor space are available, averaging AED 7.3 million. The largest residential unit is a 5-bedroom villa, featuring 6 bathrooms and 5,868 sq. ft. of floor space, with prices starting at AED 5 million. You can compare the prices with the properties for sale in Dubai.

Rental Properties in Mina Al Arab

For those interested in renting properties in Mina Al Arab, the annual rent for a studio flat begins at AED 14,000. 1-bedroom rental apartments are available for AED 28,000. 2-bedroom apartments can be rented for at least AED 50,000 annually. The largest option, a 3-bedroom rental suite, demands an annual rental rate of at least AED 60,000. You can rent a  3-bedroom villa in Mina Al Arab for a starting price of AED 65,000 per year.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Mina Al Arab?

data.answer:
Life in Mina Al Arab offers a harmonious blend of tranquility and luxury. This waterfront community is renowned for its pristine beaches, lush green landscapes, and serene lagoons, creating an idyllic setting for residents. 

With various dining, retail, and entertainment options within the community, residents enjoy a vibrant social scene. Mina Al Arab is ideal for families, professionals, and nature enthusiasts, providing a peaceful retreat away from the bustle of city life while still being well-connected to essential services and attractions.

Public Transportation in Mina Al Arab

Public transportation in Mina Al Arab Ras Al Khaimah is currently limited, primarily relying on taxis and private car services for commuting. However, the community's well-planned infrastructure ensures smooth connectivity to the major highways, making it easy for residents to access nearby areas. 

For those who prefer public transport, bus services are available from Ras Al Khaimah city center, which is a short drive away. Plans for expanding public transport options are in the works, aiming to provide more convenient and sustainable travel solutions for residents in the future.

Supermarkets in Mina Al Arab

Residents of Mina Al Arab have convenient access to several supermarkets within and near the community. The on-site supermarket offers a range of daily essentials and fresh produce, catering to the immediate needs of the residents. 

For a wider variety of shopping options, larger supermarkets such as Carrefour and Spinneys are located a short drive away in Ras Al Khaimah city center. These supermarkets provide an extensive selection of groceries, household items, and specialty products, ensuring that residents have access to everything they need for their daily lives.

Shopping Malls in and Near Mina Al Arab Area

  • Al Hamra Mall: Located approximately 10 minutes' drive from Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Mall offers a diverse range of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities, including a cinema and a family entertainment center.
  • Manar Mall: Situated around 20 minutes' drive away, Manar Mall is one of Ras Al Khaimah's largest shopping centers, featuring a wide variety of international and local brands, restaurants, and a large hypermarket.
  • RAK Mall: About a 15-minute drive from Mina Al Arab, RAK Mall provides an extensive shopping experience with numerous retail outlets, a hypermarket, and a selection of eateries.

Schools and Nurseries Near Mina Al Arab Ras Al Khaimah

There are several schools conveniently located near Mina Al Arab. Al Jazeera Al Hamra Boys' School, offering basic and secondary education, is just a 5-minute drive south of the community and is one of the highest-rated schools in the area. Also, Little Treasures Nursery is only 8 minutes west of Mina Al Arab, providing excellent early childhood education. Overall, residents have access to over 10 schools, all reachable within a 15-minute drive, ensuring a variety of educational options close to home.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Mina Al Arab

The Anglican Church of Ras Al Khaimah, located about a 20-minute drive away, serves the Christian community with regular services and events. 

For those seeking places of worship for other faiths, the city of Ras Al Khaimah has several mosques, including the Sheikh Zayed Mosque, which is approximately a 15-minute drive from Mina Al Arab, offering a serene space for daily prayers. While there are currently no Hindu temples within Mina Al Arab itself, the nearest temple is located in Dubai, around an hour and a half’s drive away. This range of places of worship ensures that residents can practice their faith comfortably and conveniently.

Clinics and Hospitals In and Near Mina Al Arab Area

Healthcare services in and around Mina Al Arab are well-developed, with various clinics and hospitals ensuring residents have access to quality medical care. The RAK Hospital, located approximately 15 minutes away, is a leading healthcare facility offering a wide range of medical services, from emergency care to specialized treatments.

Moreover, the Saqr Hospital, one of the largest public hospitals in the Emirate, is also nearby, providing comprehensive healthcare services to the community. For more routine healthcare needs, there are several clinics and medical centers, such as the Medcare Medical Centre, just a short drive away, offering general practice, dental care, and specialist consultations. These healthcare facilities ensure that residents of Mina Al Arab have convenient access to medical care, enhancing their overall well-being.

Mina Al Arab Location & Nearby Areas

Mina Al Arab is situated in the Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah, offering a picturesque setting along the Arabian Gulf. The community is strategically located, approximately 20 minutes’ drive from the city center, providing a peaceful retreat while maintaining easy access to urban amenities.

Nearby areas include the Al Hamra Village, known for its golf course and marina, and the vibrant Ras Al Khaimah city center, which offers a variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Al Marjan Island is about a 20-minute drive away from the area.

The community’s proximity to major highways also ensures convenient connectivity to other parts of the UAE, including Dubai, which is about a 45-minute drive away. This prime location makes Mina Al Arab an ideal place to live, blending tranquility with accessibility to key attractions and services.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Mina Al Arab

data.answer:
Mina Al Arab offers a variety of activities and attractions for residents and visitors alike. Nature enthusiasts can explore the beautifully landscaped parks and nature trails, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a family picnic. The community’s pristine beaches provide a tranquil spot for sunbathing, swimming, and enjoying water sports such as kayaking and paddleboarding. 

For those interested in marine life, the wetlands within Mina Al Arab are a sanctuary for various bird species and offer excellent bird-watching opportunities. The Lagoon Walk is another popular spot, featuring scenic promenades, retail shops, and cultural events, making it a vibrant hub for social activities and entertainment.

Restaurants in Mina Al Arab

Mina Al Arab restaurants offer a delightful experience with a range of restaurants catering to diverse tastes. Marjan Island Resort & Spa hosts several dining options, including Al Liwan Restaurant, which serves a variety of local and international dishes in a chic setting and Waves Cafe. Breeze Restaurant offers a relaxed dining atmosphere with a menu featuring international cuisine, perfect for family meals or casual dining. 

For those craving Italian cuisine, Pesto Ristorante offers authentic Italian dishes with stunning waterfront views. Additionally, the Lagoon Walk features several casual dining spots and cafes, providing a variety of culinary options to suit every palate.

Beaches Near Mina Al Arab

Mina Al Arab boasts several beautiful beaches within the community, providing a perfect escape for sun-seekers and water enthusiasts. The private beaches within the community are well-maintained and offer a peaceful retreat for residents, with amenities such as loungers and beach umbrellas. 

For a more active beach day, residents can head to the nearby Al Hamra Beach, just a short drive away, which offers a range of water sports activities including jet skiing, windsurfing, and snorkeling. Al Marjan Island, located nearby, also features pristine beaches with crystal-clear waters, making it an ideal spot for a day of relaxation and fun in the sun.

Hotels in Mina Al Arab

Jannah Hotel Apartments and Villas is a 4-star serviced hotel that features numerous serviced villas, offering luxurious amenities and a resort-style lifestyle. The Cove Rotana Resort is a popular choice nearby, offering stunning villas with private pools, a private beach, and multiple dining options. Another excellent option is the Hilton Garden Inn Ras Al Khaimah, located close by, providing modern amenities, comfortable rooms, and easy access to the community’s attractions. 

The Marjan Island Resort & Spa offers a range of accommodation options, from well-appointed rooms to spacious suites, along with a variety of recreational facilities including a spa, fitness center, and multiple dining venues. These hotels ensure a comfortable and enjoyable stay, whether for a weekend getaway or a longer vacation.

While Mina Al Arab offers a tranquil and luxurious lifestyle, there are a few considerations for potential residents. Public transportation options are currently limited, making it essential for residents to have their own vehicle for convenient commuting.

What types of properties are available in Mina Al Arab?

Mina Al Arab offers a variety of residential options, including waterfront villas, spacious townhouses, and modern apartments. These properties come with various amenities and are designed to provide luxurious living with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, lagoons, and lush landscapes.

How far is Mina Al Arab from Ras Al Khaimah city center?

Mina Al Arab is approximately a 20-minute drive from Ras Al Khaimah city center. This convenient distance allows residents to enjoy the tranquility of a waterfront community while having easy access to the city's shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

Are there any schools and nurseries in or near Mina Al Arab?

Yes, there are several schools and nurseries near Mina Al Arab. Al Jazeera Al Hamra Boys' School is just a 5-minute drive south, offering basic and secondary education. Little Treasures Nursery is about 8 minutes west of the community. In total, over 10 schools can be reached within a 5 to 15-minute drive, providing ample educational options for families.

What amenities are available to residents of Mina Al Arab?

Residents of Mina Al Arab enjoy a wide range of amenities, including private beaches, parks, swimming pools, fitness centers, and various dining and retail options. The community also offers water sports facilities, walking trails, and beautifully landscaped gardens, ensuring a vibrant and active lifestyle.

What are some popular attractions near Mina Al Arab?

Popular attractions near Mina Al Arab include Al Hamra Village, with its golf course, marina, and shopping mall, and the National Museum of Ras Al Khaimah, which offers insights into the region's history. Families can visit Iceland Water Park, just a 15-minute drive away, while adventure seekers can explore Jebel Jais, the highest peak in the UAE, located about an hour's drive from the community.
